new_jobs.jd: **Requirements** **Description \& Requirements** **關於我們** lululemon 是一家專門製作瑜伽、跑步、訓練和其他運動項目等機能服飾的創新公司。在高科技布料和功能設計方面，我們樹立標竿，創造顛覆性的產品和體驗，持續在運動健身、心靈成長、人際連結與幸福感方面提供人們所需的協助。我們將成功歸功於創新的產品、對門市的重視、對員工的承諾以及在每個所在社群當中所建立的人際連結。作為一家公司，我們專注於創造正面的改變，期許打造更健康、繁榮的未來。特別值得一提的是，這樣的期許也包含了為我們的員工創造一個公平、包容且注重成長的環境。 **工作摘要** 教育專員角色是組織成功的基礎。在我們的零售門市中，教育專員是創造世界級客戶服務或顧客體驗的專家。他們負責接洽顧客並與他們建立連結、分享最高品質的產品教育，與真摯地講述我們的社群和文化。 **工作的核心職責** **客戶（即顧客）體驗和社群** * 以重視顧客時間的方式與其互動，確保卓越的顧客體驗。 * 評估顧客的需求，提供客製化、有效的採購與退貨解決方案和支援。 * 清楚表達產品的價值與優點，向顧客分享技術產品知識。 * 根據公司標準，透過進行精確、及時的顧客交易並執行與市場相關的全通路計畫，促進完美流暢的端對端顧客體驗。 * 動態巡視整個樓面範圍以持續與顧客接洽，並隨時留意各種顧客或門市的需求。 * 接受顧客的意見回饋，與門市領導者合作採取適當的行動，讓顧客覺得「服務到位」。 * 告知顧客當地社群計畫。規劃並執行本地、區域性和地區性的社群專案和計畫（例如：本地跑步俱樂部、國際瑜伽日）。 **與他人合作** * 秉持真摯友善的態度並頌揚多樣性，營造一個彼此尊重且具包容性的團隊環境，確保為所有團隊成員和顧客打造備受關心且引人入勝的體驗。 * 與所有團隊成員建立充滿支持且有益成效的關係。 * 與團隊成員合作，確保提供理想的顧客體驗，並支援門市營運。 **經營** * 根據公司標準執行產品展示任務（例如，將商品放回原位、補貨，或將售完的商品從庫存補回樓面、減少庫存或重新放置商品）。 * 使用門市內的技術來支援門市營運，並提供正面的顧客體驗。 * 在值班期間視需要進行清潔工作，維護門市的奢華環境。 * 瞭解並遵守人員安全政策和程序，以維護安全的工作環境。 * 根據適用的政策、程序和法律或法規來執行工作。 **我們尋找的特質** * 包容與多元：建立／支持一個重視／讚揚差異性的包容環境 * 誠信／誠實：秉持誠實、公平與道德的態度行事 * 顧客體驗：熱愛工作且樂於建立連結、理解並協助顧客 * 個人責任：接受責任／為行動負責；是他人可以信賴的對象 * 自我意識：意識到他人會如何看待自己的言行，或會如何影響他人 * 共同合作與團隊合作：有效地與他人合作來達成目標；尋找不同的觀點 * 熱情：對自己的工作充滿熱情；尋找讓工作有趣且能參與其中的方法 **工作要求** **資格** * 在受指派門市的司法管轄區內具備合法工作的資格。 **可工作時間** * 願意彈性安排上班時間。 **其他意願要求** * 願意在值班期間的大多數時間於門市樓面走動，協助顧客並完成工作 * 願意與團隊合作，也願意獨立完成部分工作 **工作才能（有的話很好，但非必備條件）** * 教育：高中或中學文憑的同等或更高學歷。 由經理聯絡成功進入面試的應徵者。請注意，如果任何應徵者或員工認為需要合理的無障礙支援來履行其工作的基本職責，歡迎在安排面試時與經理討論此需求。 **薪資以外事宜（福利與津貼）** 在 lululemon，我們注重並投資在身、心、靈的全人發展上。我們的總獎勵計畫旨在協助您實現目標，讓您專注在喜愛的事物上。除了理想的基本薪資和團隊制的獎金計畫外，我們還提供有薪假、慷慨的員工折扣、健身/瑜珈課、親子充值計畫以及個人和專業發展計畫。 請注意：這些福利和津貼的資格可能會根據您的據點和職務類型而有所不同，並可能有一定的資格要求。本公司保留在不事先通知的情況下，隨時更改全部或部分福利的權利。 **Who We Are** lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. new_jobs.jd: **About BJAK** The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. **The Role** We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI\-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app. This is not a research\-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams. **What You Will Build** * Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems. * Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows. * Create AI\-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence. * Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production. * Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust. * Turn manual processes into reliable AI\-enabled systems that can scale. **What We Look For** * Hands\-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience. * Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI\-enabled tools. * Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack. * Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not. * Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time. * Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus. **This Role Is Not For** * People who only want research projects with no production ownership. * Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems. * Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact. * People who overclaim AI impact without evidence. * Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams. **The Bar** We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (GenAI)
new_jobs.jd: **關於 Onramp Lab** Onramp Lab 成立於 2015 年，是一支橫跨台北與洛杉磯、70 多人的團隊。我們自有並營運多個事業體，結合績效行銷（Performance Marketing）、UX 與轉換率優化，以及堅實的自有工程團隊，來打造這些事業並擴大其規模。 與接案公司或外包廠商不同，我們做的是自己的產品。台北的工程團隊從頭到尾完整負責這些產品，因此你交付的每一項成果，都會直接推動一個真實營運中的事業。 我們是一間「實際在用 AI」而非「只是說說」的公司：從工程、人資到行銷，各團隊都在日常工作流程中運用 AI，並打造自己的 agent 來自動化實際工作。在這裡，AI 不是試驗性的專案，而是我們每天的工作方式。 **關於 ContactLoop** ContactLoop 是我們自有並營運的事業之一：一個 AI 驅動的對話式平台，透過語音、簡訊（SMS）與網頁即時聊天（Webchat），將高意願客戶帶到企業的銷售團隊面前，並具備跨管道的統一記憶——AI 記得上一通電話、上一段對話，以及客戶在每個管道中的意圖。至今已支援超過 2,500 萬次商業對話，產品涵蓋 AI 語音（VoiceFusion）、AI 網頁聊天（ChatFusion）、對話式簡訊行銷，以及 AI 銷售培訓。 **關於這個職位** Forward Deployed Engineer 是當前 AI 領域最具價值、卻仍被低估的人才類型之一。頂尖實驗室正在爭奪這類人才，但市場尚未完全跟上。我們選擇直接招募這個職位。 你是一位「嵌入式建造者」（embedded builder）。你貼近業務、直接與真正擁有問題的人對話（營運、業務、產品、管理層），並弭平「最先進的 AI 能做到什麼」與「實際在正式環境中運作的是什麼」之間的落差。你不會只寫規格然後丟給別人——你親自寫程式、除錯，並當場把解決方案交付出來。 這個職位要找的，是一位具備高度自主性（high agency）與創業者思維的工程師：面對模糊的業務問題，會把它當成需要從頭到尾解決的事，而不是往上呈報的事。 **工作內容** * 嵌入業務，當場交付成果。 把與利害關係人的一場對話，直接變成可運作的成果，再帶回產品中。這正是 Forward Deployed 的工作方式，而且應用在我們真正自有的事業上。 * 打造客製化的 agentic 解決方案。 從快速原型一路做到正式環境等級的 agentic workflow（multi\-agent 系統、MCP server、會使用工具的 agent），並帶來可衡量的成效。 * 掃除上線前的障礙。 解決那些不起眼、卻會卡住 AI 順利上線的難題：整合的複雜度、資料是否到位、狀態管理，以及系統的可靠性。 * 用 AI 打造 AI。 指揮 AI agent 撰寫、測試與重構程式碼，用打字或用語音皆可。由你來審核、引導，並對成果負責。 * 成為回饋迴路。 你在第一線學到的東西，會形塑我們下一步要做什麼。你把真實世界的摩擦轉化為產品方向。 * 讓 agent 在你下線後繼續產出。 把工作排進晚上的佇列，讓成果在早上就已就緒。讓你的一天從審核產出開始，而不是從零開始。 **我們期待的條件** 比起年資，我們更在意你能實際用 AI 建造出什麼。我們要找的是應用建造者（application builder），而非純研究或純基礎架構背景的人。 * 你真的建造並上線過 LLM 驅動的應用（RAG、agent workflow、function calling、MCP、evals），並且能解釋設計上的取捨，而不只是會呼叫 API * 高度自主性與創業者思維：你會把模糊的問題從頭到尾扛下來，並推動它變成真正在正式環境中運作的東西 * 扎實的軟體工程基礎（具備 Fullstack 背景為加分，非必要條件） * 能自在地直接與非工程背景的相關人員合作：在沒有現成規格的情況下，把業務問題轉化為可運作的系統 * 對 AI 開發工具有深入的實戰經驗，你能具體展示用這些工具建造或自動化過的東西，而不只是「用過」 * 具備「指揮者」而非「打字員」的思維：你委派給智慧系統，並審核其產出 * 發自內心的好奇心：你關注模型發布與生態系變化，是因為你真的想知道 **加分條件** * 正式環境的 agentic 系統經驗（multi\-agent 協作、MCP server、工具使用） * 即時語音 AI 或電話系統經驗（Twilio、VAPI、WebSocket streaming、STT/TTS） * 正式環境中的 LLM 成本與延遲優化經驗 * 熟悉多個 AI 生態系（Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、AWS Bedrock） **你會接觸的技術** 不需要全部都會，我們更在意你上手新東西的速度。 * Voice AI： Twilio、VAPI.ai、Deepgram、ElevenLabs * LLM： Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、AWS Bedrock * 後端： PHP（Laravel）、Python（FastAPI） * 前端： React、TypeScript * 基礎架構： AWS（ECS/EKS、Aurora、ElastiCache、OpenSearch）、Datadog、CircleCI **我們提供** * 公司提供 Claude Team plan，包含 Claude Code。我們期待你來指揮，所以舞台由我們準備 * 升降桌與雙螢幕 * 人體工學椅／周邊設備補助 * 個人硬體／設備預算 * 辦公室鄰近捷運台北市政府站（信義區） **面試流程** 1. HR 線上初篩（至多約 60 分鐘）：先透過一次線上通話，了解你的背景、你在找什麼樣的機會，以及相關安排 2. 技術面談（遠端，約 60 分鐘）：你的工程背景與真實的 AI 實戰經驗 3. 與團隊的實作環節（現場，約 120 分鐘）：一起進行真實的 AI 輔助開發，使用你自己慣用的 AI 工具 4. 付費專案（選擇性，視情況而定）：針對部分候選人，我們可能會提出一個短期的付費專案，作為更深入的雙向評估。我們重視你的時間。

new_jobs.title: Physical AI Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **About VicOne** VicOne is a leader in Physical AI cybersecurity, protecting AI\-powered vehicles and robotic systems. Our Data Driven AI Flywheel combines automated vulnerability discovery, AI\-generated PoC validation, and real\-time Runtime Protection covering the full product lifecycle. You'll work on real\-world attack research, large\-scale telemetry data, and a fast\-evolving AI toolchain. We're redefining how cybersecurity is done with AI and you'll help build it. **The Role** We are looking for a Physical AI Engineer to own product development for our two core AI\-robot cybersecurity products: Radeis (pre\-deployment AI security scanning platform) and Rthena (runtime protection for operational robots). This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML, robotics, and cybersecurity, translating research capabilities into production\-grade features that help robot manufacturers secure their robots from design through deployment. **What You'll Do** * Lead end\-to\-end product development for Radeis and Rthena, from requirement gathering to release * Develop and integrate AI\-based security scanning capabilities (LLM red\-teaming, adversarial testing, behavior\-layer risk scoring, AI SBOM/CBOM, EU AI Act compliance reporting) * Build and maintain Rthena's runtime protection components: R\-SOC dashboard, adaptive defense agent, and AI\-model integrity verification * Bridge research outputs (robot\-VLM attack patterns, jailbreak detection, physical\-layer threat modeling) into product features * Design and implement agent\-based workflows for automated security assessment pipelines * Collaborate with the research team to operationalize new attack/defense methodologies * Work with customers (quadruped/industrial robot OEMs) to validate product fit and gather feedback **What You'll Need** * MS/PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, or related field (BS \+ equivalent experience accepted) * 3\+ years in AI/ML engineering with hands\-on robotics or cyber\-physical systems experience * Deep understanding of LLM/VLM architectures and adversarial robustness * Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts (SBOM/CBOM, CWE/CVE, threat modeling) * Experience building production APIs and agent\-based systems **Nice to Have** * Experience with robot middleware (ROS/ROS2\) and physical AI simulation (Isaac Sim, Gazebo) * Experience with EU AI Act compliance frameworks * Edge deployment experience (NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, model optimization) * Background in physical AI security research or red\-teaming * Experience with multi\-agent systems and agentic workflows **Why This Role** You'll be building products at the cutting edge of AI\-robot cybersecurity, a category that didn't exist a year ago. Radeis and Rthena are the only products of their kind, backed by VicOne LabR7, and serving real robot OEM customers globally.

new_jobs.title: Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Company Overview:** At OnRampLab, we build products that help businesses connect with the right people, conversations, and talent. Today we operate three core products, ContactLoop (multi\-channel marketing), VoiceFusion (Voice AI engine), and RemoteHunter (remote talent platform) with several new product lines on the way. As we scale, we're adding a Product Manager to own product discovery, translate customer needs into clear direction, and drive cross\-functional coordination across our growing portfolio. Partnered with our Staff Engineer who leads technical execution, you'll have the room to focus on what matters most: making sure every product decision is driven by real customer value. **Job Description:** We're looking for a Product Manager to partner closely with our Staff Engineer / TPM and lead product direction, customer\-needs translation, and zero\-to\-one new product launches. You'll own what to build and why, while your engineering counterparts own technical execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, sharp under pressure, and instinctively skeptical of AI demos that look "95% there." You're a daily user of AI tools, comfortable in a US\-style work environment, and able to operate across time zones, products, and stakeholders without losing the thread. **Key Responsibilities:** * Identify what customers actually need, from interviews, support logs, usage data, and stakeholder feedback. Not just collecting requests, but judging what's worth doing. * Define what "good" means for AI products, quality bar, escalation triggers, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries. Logic over detail. * Own one new product line from zero to one, discovery, MVP, launch, and iteration. * Act as the cross\-functional hub between Taiwan engineering, overseas colleagues, and customers, keeping things moving across multiple time zones, products, and stakeholders. * Communicate product decisions clearly, to leadership, engineering, and overseas counterparts in their own language and style. * Stay current with AI capabilities, judging what's feasible now vs. worth waiting for the next model. * Absorb light program\-management work as needed, given the multi\-time\-zone, multi\-product nature of the role. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree (any field). * 2\+ years of relevant experience, B2B product, UX research, customer\-facing Product Owner, or consulting backgrounds all welcome. * Fluent English (written \+ spoken), can run daily syncs with non\-Chinese\-speaking colleagues and write clear, structured, conclusion\-first documents (no buried lead, no anti\-climax). * Cross\-cultural collaboration experience across multiple time zones, comfortable in a US\-style work environment. * Quick under pressure, calm in chaos, can decide next steps with incomplete information. * Flexible communicator, adapts style for different audiences (leadership, engineering, overseas colleagues, customers) and gets people and things moving. * Sensitive to AI product quality, sees an AI demo and instinctively asks "what about the remaining 5%?" rather than being impressed by the 95%. * Daily user of AI tools (Claude / ChatGPT / Cursor / Notion AI), occasional use is not enough for this role. * Self\-directed, knows what to do next without being told and fills gaps proactively. **Bonus \& Plus:** * Overseas (US / Europe) work or living experience. * Background in Voice AI, Conversational AI, MarTech, or Sales Tech. * Hands\-on with AI prototyping tools (Claude Code, v0, Cursor), able to independently build simple prototypes. * Has previously defined evaluation criteria or success metrics for AI products. **Ideal Traits:** * Thrives in a fast\-paced, "just do things" startup environment. * Comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing structure where processes are still evolving. * Curious and self\-driven, with a willingness to learn and adapt quickly. * Collaborative and respectful communicator, building positive relationships with engineering, leadership, and customers.

new_jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **About BJAK** The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile\-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. **The Role** BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it. This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third\-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI\-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own a vertical end\-to\-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against. * Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money\-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third\-party\-rail reliance and rail\-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery. * Make hard trade\-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back. * Treat regulated constraints as first\-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward\-readiness. * Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI\-surfaced number traces back to a real record. * Ship against external gates — build feature\-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears. * Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. **What You'll Need** * Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end\-to\-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers. * Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify. * Domain — experience in a regulated / high\-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast\-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control). * AI judgement — hands\-on with LLM\-based products; can frame a feature as eval\-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data\-blocked vs model\-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all. * Nice to have — engineer or highly\-technical\-PM background * zero\-to\-one * shipped AI\-heavy consumer products * defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems * AI UX \+ failure\-handling intuition * SEA market experience. **Outcomes** * Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap * Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch * Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds * AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted * Trade\-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged * Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction ****Location**** This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week. ****Language**** English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. ****Interview Process**** Our process is designed to move fast: * Online assessment or practical task * Role\-specific interview * CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
